condition.expression: en_measured AND NOT en_present AND vin_present AND (NOT vcc_measured OR vcc_present) AND no_confirmed_short
condition.notes: EN was measured and is absent while VIN is present. The regulator is not enabled. If VCC was also measured-absent, the VCC fault (RULE_FAULT_VCC_ABSENT) takes priority. Fault is in the EN source (EC, GPIO, supervisor) or the EN path, NOT in the regulator itself.

next_steps.action: EN is absent with VIN+VCC present. The regulator is not enabled. Check the EN source (EC GPIO, voltage supervisor, or self-enable tie). A floating EN reads random; tie it per the datasheet. Do NOT condemn the regulator.

measure.where: EN source (EC/supervisor) and the EN pin
measure.expected: EN at logic-high (per datasheet threshold) when the rail should be on.

interpretations.if_result: EN high at source, low at pin
interpretations.then: Open path or pull-down. Check the series resistor and any pull-down FET.
EN source (EC/supervisor) is not asserting enable. Diagnose the source — this rail is a symptom of an upstream sequencing decision.
